# Lorna Vane

- **Age:** 28 years old (in volume 4)  <sub>[v4 c13 P15](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0015)</sub>

- **Role:** former schoolteacher, landlady, and farmer  <sub>[v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022), [v4 c11 P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035), [v4 c22 P24](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

Lorna possesses extraordinary, breathtaking beauty, with ocean-blue eyes, light skin, and golden hair that glistens like fire. She has a tall, fine physique and delicate, clear-cut features. She frequently wears inexpensive cream-colored dresses accented by a vivid flash or spark of crimson, such as a red geranium at her collar or a crimson scarf.

_Sources: [v4 c10 P28](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0028), [v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015), [v4 c12 P5](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0005), [v4 c23 P24](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0024), [v4 c27 P7](../source/v04-c27.md#nw-v04-c27-p0007), [v4 c38 P1](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0001)_

## Personality

Lorna is highly intelligent, ambitious, proud, and intensely loyal, holding a deep affection for her loved ones. Years of isolation and tragedy initially rendered her distant, aloof, and prone to moody reticence. When relaxed or in warm company, however, she displays a swift, sharp wit, vibrant humor, and deep passion. She is fiercely self-sacrificing and harbors a great love for nature, books, and literature.

_Sources: [v4 c10 P18](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0018), [v4 c10 P29](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0029), [v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015), [v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022), [v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027), [v4 c11 P29](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0029), [v4 c13 P3](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0003), [v4 c14 P6](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0006), [v4 c25 P15](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0015)_

## History

Lorna grew up in Seven Gulls, enduring a tragic youth marked by the sudden death of her brother Julian and the suicide of her father. Despite these horrors, she pursued an education at Regent's Academy and taught at the Glen school. To save her family farm from foreclosure, she surrendered her dreams and married Rufus Vane. Shortly after her mother's death, Rufus departed for sea; years later, Captain Saul brought back a brain-damaged man believed to be Rufus, whom Lorna faithfully nursed for eleven years in near poverty.

Upon the arrival of Nell and Hugh Carrow, Lorna gradually formed a close but complex friendship with Nell. When Lorna hosted author Adrian Treleaven as a summer lodger, she secretly fell in love with him, though she felt constrained by her marital ties. Later, she agreed to let Hugh arrange a surgical operation in Montreal for her incapacitated companion. The surgery restored his memory, revealing that he was actually Rufus's cousin, Laurence Vane, and that the real Rufus Vane had died of yellow fever in Cuba thirteen years prior. Unbound and free, Lorna returned to Seven Gulls, took up temporary residence with Nell, and rekindled her connection with Adrian Treleaven.

## Background by volume

- Daughter of Frank Ainslie and Rose Kerr  <sub>[v4 c11 P4](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0004), [v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015)</sub>
- Witnessed the horrific death of her four-year-old brother Julian at age twelve  <sub>[v4 c11 P16](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0016)</sub>
- Discovered her father's body after he committed suicide by hanging when she was fourteen  <sub>[v4 c11 P4](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0004), [v4 c11 P20](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0020)</sub>
- Completed two years of study in one at Regent's Academy to earn her teaching certificate  <sub>[v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022)</sub>
- Taught at the Glen school  <sub>[v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022)</sub>
- Coerced by her mother into marrying Rufus Vane to prevent foreclosure on their farm  <sub>[v4 c11 P26](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0026), [v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027)</sub>
- Spent eleven years taking care of an incapacitated, memory-lacking man brought back from Havana who was believed to be Rufus  <sub>[v4 c11 P33](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0033), [v4 c11 P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035)</sub>
